The client authors the ExfiltrationPoint objects at runtime from ArenaMapRegistry.Bowl.Exits (ArenaMapPort.Shared/ArenaMapDescriptor.cs): names, positions and box sizes there must equal this file (BowlMapTests). OFFLINE DRAFT, not walked on the host yet. One gate beyond each pocket as seen from the pocket: the BTR gate south of the east pocket's BTR_82_closed opening (the BTR stands at x 46.8..55.7, z -23.6..-19.4), the Army gate north of the west pocket's Gates_Army (x -54.1..-49.3, z -55.2..-54.2). Both boxes (4 x 3 x 4 m) lie on Arena's own 4,987 m2 NavMesh main component with 5.1 m / 5.1 m of border clearance at the centre (oracle in the world frame, 2026-10-18) and at least 20.9 m / 12.3 m from every pocket marker, so nobody spawns inside a trigger box. EntryPoints is always the map's infiltration name; names double as locale keys. The pockets open at raid start through opened_barriers (DOORS_SPAWN_A, DOORS_SPAWN_B), so a raid before item 7's bake may not reach them.
